title: Committee grader form (threshold-committee-eval P4)
description: One grader's gated grade for one slot. A grade counts ONLY with a form valid against this schema; _validate_form in committee_grade.py mirrors it by hand (no jsonschema dependency — plan deviation 7).

queryId.description: Id of the query version the grader saw.

arm.description: Which retrieval arm produced the chunk list.

chunks.description: Exactly the hashes listed in the brief, each once; the per-chunk grade vector is compared across the trio (3/3 identical required, majority never accepted).

hash.description: Chunk hash exactly as given in the brief.

grade.description: A = 1 (the chunk answers the query), 0 = it does not (PoC rubric).

overall.description: One-sentence overall judgement; not part of the consistency vector.
